draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Koramangala! Planned as a suburb after independence, it filled up during Bengaluru's late 1990s tech boom and is now one of the city's big startup hubs.
draft.hungryLine: Koramangala is packed with places to eat, so wander the tree-lined roads and follow the busiest crowd.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Balasubramania Swamy Temple is a 2 minute walk, and Nexus Mall on Hosur Road was the first shopping mall in Bengaluru.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Madiwala Lake, one of the biggest in Bengaluru, and look out for pelicans in winter.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Srinivagilu, a corner of Koramangala, has a recorded history going back to at least the 8th century, with a hero stone and a Tamil inscription near a Shiva temple.

spots.name: Nexus Mall
spots.detail: On Hosur Road · Bengaluru's first mall, with 12 cinema screens

spots.name: Madiwala Lake
spots.detail: Next door in BTM Layout · One of the city's biggest lakes

tips.title: Visit Madiwala Lake in winter.
tips.body: Spot-billed pelicans migrate here, especially in November and December.

tips.title: Join a frisbee game.
tips.body: The Ultimate Frisbee Club plays on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings from 6:30AM, and all skill levels are welcome.

story.title: Srinivagilu stones
story.body: A hero stone in Kannada script and an incomplete Tamil inscription near a Shiva temple show this area was settled at least 1,200 years ago.

story.title: Sparse fields
story.body: People heading to Bommanahalli usually bypassed Koramangala, and more houses only went up in the late 1970s.

story.title: St. John's arrives
story.body: St. John's Medical College was set up next door in Madiwala in 1963.

story.title: The tech boom
story.body: Sitting between Bengaluru and Electronic City, Koramangala drew people from across India and grew into a startup hub.

story.title: Crowded and green
story.body: Koramangala is split into eight blocks over about 1,800 acres, with over 22,000 people per square km as of 2026.
